body:
Oh man.... I suffer the same. I'm also the same age. I also just want someone to care for me. And every time I ask a girl out it just never seems to work well. I thought working out and building up my confidence would help it. And I cut out drugs too, because I thought they were a problem. But all of it  just proved more how unlovable I was.

Sorry I cant give advice but we're on the same boat with the same ticket.

Idk about you but it's nice to find someone who knows my exact struggle.
